text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In 1st place is Admire Vega, it's Admire 
Vega! Seizing the glory of Derby Umamusume 
is Admire Vega!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(The cheers... the sheer roar... It feels 
like it's numbing me to my very core.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(My feet feel light and dizzy. A fever so 
intense it's hard to even stand...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (A fluttering in my chest... this heat!)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...I didn't let Top Road-san catch up.

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Mother
text_block_list.text:
In that long—seemingly eternal final 
stretch, squeezing out the very last drop 
of your strength, how did it feel to take 
the lead?

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Mother
text_block_list.text:
How did it feel... to bask in the 
thunderous roars of Fuchu all to yourself?

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Mother
text_block_list.text: Did you enjoy it... to the fullest...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaaaaaaah!! Damn it! Damn it! It's so 
frustrating!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
That just means I still want to beat you 
even more.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'll retrain at the summer camp. Focusing 
on stamina, giving it my all!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: And so— Let's race again, Ayabe-san.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Next time, at the Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: At the Kikuka Sho... once more.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I welcome Admire Vega as she returns to 
the waiting room after finishing the race.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Opera was there, too... And Top Road-san 
was there as well.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
choice_data_list: But, I believed you would win.
Still, I believed you would win.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
choice_data_list:
Because I believed in your closing kick, 
in your strength!

Because I believed in your closing kick, 
in your strength!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As she gave only that brief reply and 
briskly began preparing for the concert, I 
watched her back and renewed my own 
resolve.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Next is the Kikuka Sho, the final leg of 
the Classic Triple Crown route. To make 
her shine at the absolute peak once more, 
I must give it my all as well—!
